facts.text: Audrey confirmed that the dogs enjoy playing in the garden, often running around and exploring.

evidence.quote: Yeah, they do enjoy the garden! Always running around, exploring and having a great time. So adorable!

facts.text: The dogs are described as easy to care for, requiring only water and sufficient sunlight.

evidence.quote: Nope, they're easy to take care of, perfect for me! Just gotta water them and make sure they get enough sun.

facts.text: Audrey mentioned that the dogs are her 'fur babies' and are the only ones she has.
Audrey expressed a strong emotional bond with the dogs, stating they mean everything to her.
